static_traits.name: Chen Haili
static_traits.educational_background: Has attended cooking courses and workshops
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends' support and encouragement, but tends toward self-isolation due to Self-doubt about cooking, reducing communication with family and friends
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before; no similar prior psychological problem history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe automatic thoughts and goals concretely, high cooperation; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: After failing a cooking show audition, I started believing no one appreciates my cooking, even feeling people do not like me as a person; this makes me doubt my cooking ability and feel Being rejected.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent negative self-talk and doubt about cooking ability affect my motivation and self-esteem; I hope to gain support, walk out of these negative thoughts, and rebuild confidence in cooking.
growth_experiences: An important cooking show audition failed: judges' feedback was 'dishes lack inspiration and are not balanced enough'; after the results were announced, the belief 'no one appreciates my cooking, others do not like me' started appearing. Since then, when Cooking for others or receiving feedback, repeatedly replaying the judges' voices in mind (such as 'your cooking is not good enough' 'no one likes your dishes'), gradually leading to Decreased drive, Increased self-doubt, Distant relationships with friends and family, and accompanying changes in mood and eating habits.

core_beliefs: My cooking is not good enough, not worthy of recognition

special_situations.event: Failing the cooking show audition and receiving judges' feedback (calling the dishes 'lacking inspiration and not balanced enough')
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one important audition fails, it means I have no talent and am not good enough overall
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps cooking and proactively seeks feedback to prove and improve self
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one appreciates my cooking; they do not like me

special_situations.event: Cooking for others or receiving feedback after meals
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as someone points out inadequacies, it equals them not liking me as a person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces contact with relatives and friends, avoids socializing to escape evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They hate my cooking, and do not even like me

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback is not credible; others are just being polite
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite, and do not truly like it

special_situations.event: Others give mild criticism or improvement suggestions on dishes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any negative opinion means overall failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays the judges' criticism in mind, lowering cooking motivation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My dishes are not good enough; no one will like them

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and liked, hoping his work is appreciated and his value seen
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and Being rejected, worrying oneself is not worthy of being liked
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of being negated by keeping distance from others
Trying to prove self-worth by constantly seeking external feedback

object_relations.linking_affect: Shame, sense of being rejected, Anxiety

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others give positive feedback or praise for her cooking
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to understand praise as insincere politeness (transference: seeing the outside world's positive signals as untrustworthy)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Attributing praise to 'politeness' with interpretive statements, flat tone, quickly displacing the topic, and emphasizing the other person is 'just too embarrassed to say it directly'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others offer mild criticism or improvement suggestions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating partial criticism with negation of the whole self, believing 'they do not like me' (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-critical statements (such as 'it is all because I am not good enough'), low tone, actively avoiding further communication, expressing willingness to withdraw or reduce socializing.

manifestations: Tending toward self-isolation after developing Self-doubt about cooking ability, reducing communication with friends and family
Struggling to discuss Self-doubt with supportive friends
outcomes: Worsening Low mood and sense of being rejected

manifestations: Shaken value and passion as a Chef after the failed audition
Repeatedly hearing the negating 'judges' voices' while cooking

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'owning'; expressed in language like 'he looks down on me' 'they want to exclude me'.
manifestations: Interpreting others' mild criticism as 'they do not like me'
Presuming others hold negating attitudes in cooking and feedback situations

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treating the judges' negative comments ('lacking inspiration, not balanced enough') as the final verdict on self and works
While cooking, repeatedly replays the judges' voices in one's mind

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly second-guesses every dish (second-guess), finding it hard to accept positive feedback

positive_force: Strong passion for and dedication to cooking
Has the support and encouragement of a few close friends
Willing to cooperate in setting SMART goals and trying behavioral experiments
After setbacks, still keeps cooking and proactively seeks feedback
negative_force: Cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mind reading and negating the positive
Self-isolation, Reduced socializing and support acquisition
Highly sensitive to negative feedback and tends toward mental filtering

target_behavior.behavior: Intense negative automatic thoughts and Self-doubt when Receiving feedback from others or Cooking for others
antecedent: Memories of the failed cooking show audition and the judges' negating feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing negative feedback, internalizing it as the 'I am not liked/my cooking is not good enough' core belief
target_behavior.function: Escaping the pain of being negated, protecting self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased drive, struggling to keep pursuing a cooking career, Low mood and Impaired self-esteem

antecedent: Interacting with others after developing Self-doubt about cooking
Anticipating situations of Being criticized or evaluated
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing Being rejected and negated, and inferring others do not like oneself through mind reading
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged Interpersonal relationships, Reduced social support obtained, intensified Loneliness
